quote: This guard now falls through and publishes the invalidated snapshot while replacement facts are pending; the base guard rejected it. Treat absent facts like an unknown assistant fact when the captured revision has been superseded.
note: The P2 item “Reject superseded backfills when retained facts are absent” identifies the same race in which a running backfill republishes an older preview after broad invalidation clears the retained facts. The PR author acknowledged the finding and recorded it as a follow-up.
